reason: Suppress intentional no-reply outcomes for ambient channel conversations

quality.summary: The route guard is scoped to non-scheduled ambient conversations, the marker must be the complete bounded output, and ordinary internal-only or visible responses retain existing finalization behavior.
residual_risks: Semantic relevance remains model-decided, so behavior quality depends on the active model following the ambient-listening contract.

performance.summary: The runtime overhead is a bounded string accumulator capped near the marker length and a constant-time route check; it adds no database, network, or unbounded memory work.
residual_risks: Ambient relevance still requires one model invocation and therefore cannot have zero model-token cost.

security.summary: Suppression is restricted to an exact internal marker on ambient routes, does not broaden permissions or tool access, and never exposes marker content to the channel.
residual_risks: A model induced to emit the exact internal marker can suppress one ambient response; triggered routes and scheduled jobs are not opted into the contract.
